descriptions.notStarted: If you wish to turn your #t1902006# into a #t1902007# again, you must go see #b#p1102002#, the Mount Instructor#k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1102002# said he's learned to summon #t1902007# from #p1101001#, but that he couldn't do such a favor for someone who's careless enough to lose his #t1902007#. He then proposed that you pay him #b100,000,000 Mesos#k as a testament of your devout determination to never lose your Mount again.
descriptions.completed: You paid 100,000,000 Mesos to #p1102002# and received a #t1902007#.
